setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: A fresh session with Song mode On, its default. Channel 1 plays its default phrase through the example MIDI device and the norns shows the Device page for channel 1; nothing is playing. You will build a two-note motif (MIDI 60, 62) copied into slots 1, 2, 4 and 5, with slots 3 and 6 left empty.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Tap Song (6,8), tap (2,7), which jumps to 1 step, then tap (8,7) once. The Playback screen reads Global length 2, so every slot plays a two-note motif, 60 and 62.
steps.title: Set the global length to 2

steps.caption: Hold slot 1 at (1,1) and tap slot 2 at (2,1) to copy it, then tap slot 2. The Slot setup screen names Song 02 and the footer reads Song sequence 2 selected.
steps.title: Copy slot 1 into slot 2

steps.caption: Tap Channel (3,8), select channel 1 at (1,1) and tap octave +1 at (11,8). The footer reads Ch. 1 octave: 1 and slot 2 will sound 72 and 74.
steps.title: Raise slot 2 an octave

steps.caption: Repeat for slot 4, leaving slot 3 empty: copy slot 1 into slot 4 and give it octave +2 at (12,8). Then copy slot 1 into slot 5 and give it octave -1 at (9,8). Slots 3 and 6 stay empty, so there are two groups: slots 1 and 2, and slots 4 and 5.
steps.title: Add slots 4 and 5

steps.caption: Tap Song (6,8), tap slot 1 at (1,1) and press Play (1,8). Slot 1 sounds 60, 62, then slot 2 sounds 72, 74. Slot 3 is empty, so the group ends and playback returns to slot 1: look at the MIDI strip for 60, 62, 72, 74, 60, 62, 72, 74. Press Stop.
steps.title: Hear the first group loop
